# THE Occasion Edit
> Bespoke Balloon Styling, Sequin Shimmer Walls & Luxury Event Decor

## Service Areas & Postcode Coverage
- **Towns & Regions:** Bottesford, Vale of Belvoir, Grantham, Bingham, Melton Mowbray, Newark-on-Trent, Nottingham & surrounding East Midlands borders
- **Postcode Prefixes:** NG13, NG31, NG32, NG1, NG2, NG3, NG12, LE13, LN6
- **Delivery & Hire Policy:** Based in Bottesford, Leicestershire, we deliver, install, and collect all hire frames, shimmer walls, wooden boards, and neon signs across the Vale of Belvoir and East Midlands. Air-filled number stacks and helium packages are yours to keep.

## Interactive 3D Display Builder & Packages
Customers can visually design their custom event setup in real time at `/` (`#build-your-edit`) across 5 steps:
1. **Our 5 Signature Balloon Palettes** (or custom 5-colour mix)
2. **Backdrops & Sequin Shimmer Walls** (Arched Wooden Board, Gold/Silver/Black/Pink Shimmer Walls in Small £150 or Large £180 with garland, Circular Hoop £140 with garland, Welcome Easel £85)
3. **Organic Balloon Garlands** (7ft Side Garland £105 solo, Corner Clusters £85, Full Surround Arch £145 solo or +£25/+£35 upgrade on walls)
4. **3D Foil Numbers, Stacks & Letters** (Basic Stack £35/£55, Themed Stack £60/£80, Luxury Stack £70/£90, Helium Foil Numbers + 2 Clusters £36/£52, 16" Foil Letters £12/letter)
5. **Finishing Extras** (LED Neon Sign £35, Floral Accents £36, BABY Blocks £40, Personalised Bubble Balloon £35, Cut-Outs £36, Table Centerpieces £35, Cake Plinth £60)

## Frequently Asked Questions
### Which items are hired and which items do we keep?
All structural props — including Sequin Shimmer Walls, Arched Wooden Backdrop Boards, Circular Gold Hoops, Wooden Easels, LED Neon Signs, BABY Blocks, and Cake Plinths — are hired for your event and collected by our team afterwards. Freestanding Balloon Number Stacks, Helium Foil Numbers, Personalised Bubble Balloons, and latex balloons are yours to keep.

### What is the difference between the Small (£150) and Large (£180) Shimmer Wall packages?
Our Small Sequin Shimmer Wall package (£150 including a 7ft organic balloon garland) is ideal for home celebrations and intimate dining spaces. Our Large Sequin Shimmer Wall package (£180 including a 7ft organic balloon garland) creates a wide, floor-to-ceiling photo backdrop suited to venues, function rooms, and milestone parties.

### How far in advance should we book our event date?
We recommend submitting your custom Edit 2 to 6 weeks before your celebration to guarantee your preferred shimmer wall colour, backdrop board, and installation slot — though we always do our best to accommodate last-minute availability.

### Can you match a custom colour scheme or theme?
Yes! You can select one of our 5 Signature Palettes in Step 1 of the Builder, or switch to "Build Your Own Palette" to blend up to 5 matte, pearl, and metallic chrome balloon shades.
